blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three consumer and civic groups challenged business organizations to substantiate warnings that worsening relations with China could cost millions of Filipino jobs. CitizenWatch, Konsyumer At Mamamayan (KM) and Bantay Konsyumer, Kuryente, Kalsada (BK3) said economic concerns should not be used to pressure the Philippines into compromising its sovereignty.
